fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Short answers to what new teams ask most. Longer guides live in our help center.

default.question: How long does it take to set up Fieldnote?
default.answer: Most teams record their first interview the same day. Connect your calendar and video tool, invite your team, and Fieldnote joins the next call you schedule.

default.question: Do participants know they are being recorded?
default.answer: Always. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins a call, and you can attach a consent form to every invite.

default.question: How accurate are the transcripts?
default.answer: Around 95% for clear audio, with a label for every speaker. You can fix any line, and Fieldnote learns your product names as you go.

default.question: Can we delete a recording for good?
default.answer: Yes. Deleting removes the video, audio and transcript right away, and our backups forget it within 30 days.

default.question: What happens when the trial ends?
default.answer: Pick a plan to keep recording, or stay on the free Starter plan to keep reading everything you already have.

fields.name: cardText
fields.label: Card text
fields.default: Our support team are former researchers. They reply within one business day, usually much sooner.
